meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把模糊需求梳理成一份可直接开工的工作计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到新需求后习惯先理清步骤再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a vague request into one ready-to-execute work plan before coding
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you plan out steps before writing any code.

howto.what: 它把需求变成一份决策完整的计划,而不是动手改代码:先并行只读探索,公布受影响的用户、理想状态和差距,你说「可以」后才写出计划文件。全程只写 .omo/ 下的计划产物,永不实现。
howto.when: 只有你明确要求走 ulw-plan 流程,或在动手实现前先要一份计划时才会接管;单独跑 ulw 不会自动激活。提到「high accuracy」「deep review」等词时,计划会被要求先过高精度审查。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划:给 /login 加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流
say.note: 先只读探索,再给出计划待你确认

say.text: 先别写代码,用 ulw-plan 出一份登录改造计划,要高精度
say.note: 会要求先过 plan-reviewer 审查

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 规划这个需求,有拿不准的直接问我
say.note: 它会逐条问你,不替你决定

howto.what_en: It turns your request into one decision-complete plan instead of coding: it explores read-only, reports the affected user and gaps, and writes the plan file only after you say okay. It never implements.
howto.when_en: Only on an explicit request for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ulw run does not. Saying "high accuracy" or "deep review" makes high-accuracy review required.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to plan a 5-per-minute per-IP rate limit on /login
say_en.note: It explores read-only, then shows a plan for your OK

say_en.text: Don't code yet - have ulw-plan draft a login refactor plan, high accuracy
Plan this with ulw-plan and ask me about any open choices
say_en.note: It will interview you instead of defaulting
